title: Optimal investment under capital gains taxes
abstract: arXiv:2602.15177v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We generalize classical existence results for expected utility maximization in discrete time frictionless market models to models with capital gains taxes. We consider the realistic but mathematically challenging rule that losses do not trigger negative taxes but can only be offset against potential gains in the future. Central to the analysis is a well-known phenomenon from arbitrage-free markets with proportional transaction costs that does not exist in arbitrage-free frictionless markets: an investment in specific quantities of stocks that is completely riskless but may provide an advantage over holding money in the bank account. As a result of this phenomenon, on an infinite probability space, no-arbitrage does not imply that the set of attainable terminal wealth is closed in probability. translated_title: 资本利得税下的最优投资
translated_abstract: 我们将离散时间无摩擦市场模型中期望效用最大化问题的经典存在性结果推广到含有资本利得税的模型中。我们考虑一种现实但具有数学挑战性的规则：亏损不会引发负税收，而只能用于在未来抵扣潜在收益。分析的核心是一个来自含比例交易成本的无套利市场中（在无套利无摩擦市场中不存在）的众所周知的现象：对特定数量股票的投资是完全无风险的，但相比将资金存入银行账户可能带来优势。由于这一现象的存在，在无限概率空间上，无套利并不意味着可达到的终端财富集合在概率意义下是闭集。我们给出了该集合为闭集的简单充分条件。随后，我们刻画了可达到终端财富集合的闭包，从而……
tldr: 该论文将期望效用最大化的经典存在性结果推广到亏损只能结转抵扣而不能产生负税的资本利得税离散时间市场模型中，并刻画了可达到终端财富集合的闭包及其为闭集的简单充分条件。
en_tdlr: This paper generalizes classical existence results for expected utility maximization to discrete-time markets with capital gains taxes, where losses can only be carried forward to offset future gains, and characterizes the closure of attainable terminal wealth along with simple sufficient conditions for closedness.
